title: Oracle OPERA Cloud Integration Brings Hotel Guest Data Into Klaviyo - Klaviyo
summary: Connect Oracle OPERA Cloud to Klaviyo to sync guest profiles, reservations, and loyalty data, then trigger pre-arrival, in-stay, and post-stay hotel journeys.
body_markdown:
Connect hotel guest data to personalized marketing


Generated by Klaviyo AI


Klaviyo’s native Oracle OPERA Cloud integration brings guest profiles, reservations, loyalty memberships, and marketing consent into one platform. The post explains how hotels can use this data for personalized communications across the guest journey, recognize guests across properties, and meet the integration’s requirements.


-


**Connected guest data:** Hotels can start with two years of historical guest and reservation data, with new and updated information syncing every 60 minutes.


-


**Guest journey automation:** Reservation events can trigger pre-arrival offers, check-in messages, post-stay follow-ups, and rebooking journeys after cancellations or no-shows.


-


**Recognition across properties:** Hotel groups can use shared stay history and loyalty information to personalize communications while tailoring experiences to individual properties.


-


**Current loyalty information:** Synced membership tiers, points balances, and expiration dates support personalized offers and membership reminders between stays.


-


**Integration requirements:** The integration requires OPERA Cloud and Oracle’s Reporting & Analytics Data Access add-on and is included with a standard Klaviyo Customer Profile plan.


[Sign up](https://www.klaviyo.com/sign-up)[Get a demo](https://www.klaviyo.com/demo-request)


---


Your front desk knows who's arriving tomorrow, who's celebrating, and who's back for the fifth time this year. That kind of knowing is what makes a stay feel personal. The opportunity is bringing it into your marketing, too.


It starts with guest data. Reservation details, loyalty status, and stay history already live in your PMS. For groups on Oracle OPERA Cloud, connecting that data to a marketing platform has often meant a custom data project, IT support, or manual exports. Once it's connected, there's a lot more you can do:


- **Messages can follow the stay.** Instead of sending on your calendar, you can send on your guest's, with a different note for someone arriving tomorrow than for someone who checked out last week.
- **Guests can be recognized across properties.** A guest who stays at several of your hotels can be one guest in your marketing, and questions like "who's stayed with more than one property?" get easier to answer.
- **More moments become opportunities.** Cancellations, no-shows, and on-property spend at your restaurant, bar, and spa can all inform what you send next.


Today, we're excited to introduce[Klaviyo's native integration with Oracle OPERA Cloud](https://marketplace.klaviyo.com/en-us/apps/01m2rm4yvaf1k72w5ez7ppby4q/) , making it easier for hotels and hospitality groups to turn the guest data they already have into stronger relationships, more direct bookings, and more revenue.


Now, hotel marketers can connect Oracle OPERA Cloud directly to Klaviyo and bring guest profiles, reservation history, loyalty memberships, and marketing consent into one place.


"Hotel groups on OPERA hold some of the richest guest data in the industry, and until now putting it to work in marketing meant a custom engineering project,” says Mike Eng, Hospitality Lead at Klaviyo. “This integration lets marketing teams recognize their guests across properties and give them a reason to book direct again, with less lift from IT.”


Oracle OPERA Cloud is the property management system behind a large share of the world's leading hotel groups, and it's our most requested hotel integration. It joins Mews, Cloudbeds, and Guesty, which already help independent hotels and smaller groups do the same.


## What You Can Accomplish with Oracle OPERA Cloud and Klaviyo


Hospitality is built on knowing your guests.


A returning guest shouldn't have to introduce themselves every time they visit a different property. A loyalty member should feel recognized wherever they stay. And someone arriving tomorrow should receive a very different message from someone who checked out last week.


Delivering those experiences requires more than a name and email address. Hotels need to understand where guests have stayed, when they're arriving, what they've booked, and how they've engaged with the brand over time.


Klaviyo's new Oracle OPERA Cloud integration makes that information available to marketing teams. The integration automatically brings together:


- **Guest profiles:** Contact information, guest details, VIP status, and stay history.
- **Reservations:** Arrival and departure dates, room types, rates, booking channels, property information, and reservation status.
- **Loyalty memberships:** Program membership, tier, points balance, and expiration dates.
- **Marketing consent:** Email and SMS permissions synced from OPERA Cloud.
- **Reservation activity:** Booking confirmations, check-ins, checkouts, cancellations, no-shows, and room-night events.


Hotels can start with two years of historical guest and reservation data, with new and updated information syncing every 60 minutes.


For multi-property groups, this means marketing teams can understand guest relationships across their hotel portfolio while still creating experiences tailored to individual properties.


## **Make every stage of the guest journey more personal**


The real opportunity comes from what hotels can do with this connected data.


Instead of sending the same campaign to every guest, marketers can use reservation events, stay details, and loyalty information to deliver communications that reflect where someone is in their journey.


Here are a few examples.


### **Before arrival: Turn anticipation into additional revenue**


A guest has booked a three-night stay at your resort. Seven days before arrival, Klaviyo can automatically send a personalized room-upgrade offer based on the room they've reserved.


A few days later, you might follow up with a spa treatment, dinner reservation, or another experience available at the property.


For loyalty members, those messages can also reflect their membership tier.


This gives hotels more opportunities to generate ancillary revenue before a guest even arrives, with offers that are relevant to their actual reservation.


### **During the stay: Make every guest feel recognized**


When a guest checks in, OPERA Cloud updates their reservation status. Klaviyo can use that event to trigger a welcome message with property-specific information, such as dining hours, amenities, and how to request assistance.


For a guest visiting another hotel within the same group, marketers can use their broader stay history and loyalty information to create a more familiar experience.


These small moments help make hospitality feel personal, even when a hotel group operates dozens of properties.


### **After checkout: Give guests a reason to return**


The guest relationship shouldn't end at checkout.


When a reservation is marked as checked out, Klaviyo can automatically follow up with a thank-you message, a feedback request, or an invitation to book another stay directly.


Hotels can also tailor follow-up journeys based on stay activity and spending, giving high-value guests more personalized attention.


Over time, these interactions create more opportunities to encourage repeat visits and build relationships that extend beyond a single booking.


### **When plans change: Recover bookings before guests move on**


Cancellations and no-shows are part of running a hotel. They don't necessarily have to mean losing the guest relationship.


With Klaviyo, a cancellation or no-show event can trigger a personalized rebooking journey. Hotels can tailor follow-up messages using information such as the cancellation reason and how far in advance the reservation was cancelled.


Instead of waiting for a manual report or a monthly win-back campaign, marketers can respond when the change appears in the reservation data.


### **Between stays: Keep loyalty members engaged**


Hotels can also use loyalty membership information to create ongoing relationships with their most valuable guests.


For example, a hotel group could send a reminder 90 or 30 days before a membership expires, personalize an offer based on the guest's current tier, or celebrate the anniversary of their enrollment.


Because membership information, points balances, and tier status sync directly from OPERA Cloud, marketers can build campaigns around the guest's current loyalty information rather than relying on outdated audience lists.


## How OPERA Cloud fits into Klaviyo’s hotel CRM integrations


At Klaviyo, we believe the strongest customer relationships are built when businesses can use what they know about their customers to make every interaction more relevant.


That matters especially in hospitality.


A guest might discover a hotel through a third-party booking platform, stay at multiple properties, join a loyalty program, and return months later for an entirely different experience. Each interaction adds context that can help a hotel serve that guest better.


By connecting Oracle OPERA Cloud with Klaviyo, we're making it easier for hotel groups to bring that context together and put it to work.


We're also building on Klaviyo's existing hospitality ecosystem, which includes integrations with Mews, Cloudbeds, and Guesty, to help more hospitality businesses build direct relationships with their guests.


Whether you're managing a collection of boutique hotels, a luxury resort group, or a growing portfolio of properties, the goal is the same: recognize your guests, make their experiences more personal, and give them more reasons to come back.


## If you're already a Klaviyo customer on OPERA


If you're using Klaviyo with OPERA data today, through a custom build, a data warehouse sync, or manual uploads, the native integration gives you a maintained connection, so your team spends less time keeping data flowing and more time using it.


## If you're on OPERA and new to Klaviyo


You can get started with a prebuilt connection instead of a custom build. Connect your chain, start with the pre-arrival and post-stay flows that fit your properties, and run email and text from one platform. And as guests increasingly find and book through OTAs, apps, and AI assistants, first-party guest data helps you stay familiar to your guests and gives them a reason to book direct.


## Getting Started withOracle OPERA Cloud and Klaviyo


The Oracle OPERA Cloud integration is designed for hotel groups using OPERA Cloud and Oracle's Reporting & Analytics Data Access add-on.


The integration is included with a standard Klaviyo Customer Profile plan and supports hotels using Oracle's North America, EMEA, and APAC gateways.


**Ready to turn your guest data into better guest experiences? Explore the O[racle OPERA Cloud integration in the Klaviyo App Marketplace](https://marketplace.klaviyo.com/en-us/apps/01m2rm4yvaf1k72w5ez7ppby4q/) , or talk to us about Klaviyo for hospitality.**


Erin Veltkamp


Erin Veltkamp leads product marketing for the hospitality and food and beverage industries at Klaviyo. Drawing on her background in restaurant brand strategy and customer engagement technology, she focuses on helping brands turn guest insights into more personalized experiences that drive repeat visits and lasting loyalty.
